summary.text: Apply online, or get a form, complete and sign it, then send it by mail.

details.heading: Foreign identity documents
details.body: If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, include copies of their foreign identification documents, such as a work permit or long term visit pass.

steps.name: Choose how to apply
steps.text: Apply online using the link, or pick up a CHAS application form at a Community Centre or Club, Community Development Council, Public Hospital or Polyclinic. You can also download the form.

steps.name: Complete the form
steps.text: If you use a form, complete and sign it.

steps.name: Send the form
steps.text: Send the completed and signed form to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292.

example_phrasings: How do I apply for CHAS?
Where can I get a CHAS application form?

quotes.text: You can apply for CHAS via the online application by using this link.
Please send the completed and signed application form to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292.
If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, please also include copies of their foreign identification documents (e.g. work permit/long term visit pass).
